### The Velveteen Woman
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-nov-15-2010-11640860.html
Passage: Galatians 1:10
Points:
- People often fall into religious pretending out of concern for what others think.
- Becoming authentic and vulnerable can feel painful and requires courage.
- Striving for human approval traps believers on the shelf instead of living freely.
- Jesus set the example by never pretending to be someone He was not.
- True Christian freedom comes from resting in God's acceptance despite personal flaws.

### Paul's Conversion
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pauls-conversion
Passage: Galatians 1:15-17
Points:
- Paul answers critics by showing his message originated directly from Christ, not human teachers.
- His radical transformation from persecutor to apostle provides powerful proof of divine grace.
- Like Jeremiah, Paul was set apart by God before birth for a specific redemptive purpose.
- God does not merely save believers, but graciously assigns each a vocation to serve His church.
- Believers should identify their spiritual gifts and actively pursue their God-given callings.
